Therapy and skills

Evidence-Informed Psychotherapy and Clinical Interventions

Direct answer: Evidence-informed therapy is selected according to the person’s concerns, goals, safety, and clinician scope; no single modality is right for everyone.

Understand therapy approaches and clinically framed mindfulness support.

Therapy approaches

Therapy may draw on CBT-informed, behavioural, supportive, mindfulness, family, or other approaches according to the concern, clinician, and person’s goals.

Clinical mindfulness

Mindfulness skills may support attention or coping with performance and exam stress, but they do not replace assessment or emergency care.
